# Feature: Master key — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #12 (Master key) from Keys and Locks before it is used in real levels. Effect: opens any lock, then breaks. Unique: the only key that ignores colour, once. Useful: a choice of which colour hunt to skip. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** opens any lock, then breaks.

**So that** a choice of which colour hunt to skip.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Master key for the first time in its teaching room (mech-12-master-key-room). Teaching moment: First room: a master key with a red lock nearby, whose red key is also in the room, and a blue lock further on with no blue key in sight. A player who spends the master key on the convenient red lock has nothing for the blue lock and must restart, which teaches that the master key is saved for the colour that cannot be found. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: A silver key that fits any lock
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Pressing it into a lock of any colour consumes the master key and dissolves that one lock only

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Pressing it into a lock of any colour consumes the master key and dissolves that one lock only
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Master key's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-12-master-key-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/keys-and-locks.yml mechanic #12.
